comparison.objective: Crimp a terminal or lug onto a cable; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold cable at insertion depth and alignment while closing a press versus hex-key seating, counterholding, collar adjustment, and bounded locking torque.
comparison.success_condition: Good aligned crimp, tool release, placement, and in one version a 450 N pull test versus two repeatable damped stops and setting retention.
comparison.reason: Both use bimanual force control, but the functional transformations and verification are unrelated; all six versions were read.
